candidates.title: Will Taylor Fritz win at least 3.5 more games than Thiago Agustin Tirante?
candidates.rules_primary: If the game differential in favor of Taylor Fritz across the full match is above 3.5 games in the Taylor Fritz vs Thiago Agustin Tirante professional tennis match in the 2026 ATP Stockholm Final, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary:
The following market refers to the Taylor Fritz vs Thiago Agustin Tirante professional tennis match in the 2026 ATP Stockholm Final. If the match does not occur (signaled by a ball being played) due to a player injury, walkover, forfeiture, or any other cancellation (all before the match starts), the market will resolve to a fair price in accordance with the rules. If a retirement occurs, all markets that can be unconditionally settled based on play already completed will resolve accordingly. candidates.title: Kyren Williams receiving yards ladder
candidates.rules_primary: If Each Yes contract pays $0.0025 per receiving yard recorded by Kyren Williams during the Los Angeles R vs Arizona Pro Football game originally scheduled for Nov 15, 2026. Each No contract pays $1.00 minus the Yes payout. Yes pays out at most $1.00. Then the market resolves to Yes.
